parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the scroll wheel of a computer mouse, typically made of rubber for better grip and tactile feedback.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content on the screen, and sometimes acts as a middle button when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis to provide scrolling input and can be clicked downward for additional input functionality.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the computer mouse, made of durable ABS plastic, providing structure and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the internal electronics, buttons, and wheel, and provides the surface that the user grips and moves to control the cursor.
parts.Movement_description: It moves freely across a flat surface, translating motion into cursor movement on the screen.
